name: NGC 4565 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4565, an edge-on spiral galaxy known as the Needle Galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4565-hubble
story: Hubble looks along part of the disk of the Needle Galaxy, a spiral seen edge-on, where ribbons of dust block some of the light from its stars. This close-up takes in a stretch of the disk rather than the whole galaxy.

claims.text: NGC 4565 is a spiral galaxy nicknamed the Needle Galaxy
Hubble's view shows part of its disc, edge-on and up close
Ribbons of dust block some of the light from the galactic disc
